steps.name: Conformance tests
steps.run:
set +e
mise run test-conformance 2>&1 | tee conformance-output.txt
echo "exit_code=${PIPESTATUS[0]}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Conformance test summary
steps.run:
PASS=$(grep -c -e "--- PASS:.*/" conformance-output.txt 2>/dev/null || true)
FAIL=$(grep -c -e "--- FAIL:.*/" conformance-output.txt 2>/dev/null || true)
PASS=${PASS:-0}
FAIL=${FAIL:-0}
echo "## Conformance Tests" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
echo "**Result: ${PASS} passed, ${FAIL} failed**" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
if [ "$FAIL" -gt 0 ]; then
  echo "" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
  grep -e "--- FAIL:.*/" conformance-output.txt >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY" || true
  echo '```' >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
fi
exit "${{ steps.conformance.outputs.exit_code }}"

pipelines.name: OpenSpec

steps.name: Collect change info
steps.run:
changes_json=$(openspec list --json)
count=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq '.changes | length')
echo "count=$count" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

if [ "$count" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "status=clean" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

if [ "$count" -gt 1 ]; then
  echo "status=too-many" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  names=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq -r '.changes[].name' | paste -sd ', ')
  echo "names=$names" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  exit 0
fi

name=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq -r '.changes[0].name')
change_status=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq -r '.changes[0].status')
completed=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq -r '.changes[0].completedTasks')
total=$(echo "$changes_json" | jq -r '.changes[0].totalTasks')

echo "status=active" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "name=$name" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "change_status=$change_status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "completed=$completed" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "total=$total" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

if ! validate_json=$(openspec validate "$name" --type change --json); then
  echo "$validate_json"
  exit 1
fi
valid=$(echo "$validate_json" | jq -r '.items[0].valid')
echo "valid=$valid" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

if [ "$valid" = "false" ]; then
  issues=$(echo "$validate_json" | jq -r '.items[0].issues[] | "- \(.level): \(.message)"')
  {
    echo "issues<<ISSUES_EOF"
    echo "$issues"
    echo "ISSUES_EOF"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Fail if active changes
steps.run:
echo "::error::Active OpenSpec changes must be archived before merge. Ask your AI coding agent to archive the OpenSpec change and push."
exit 1

source-ci.name: Wait for source CI and plugin validation

steps.name: Require successful source CI for this commit

publish.name: Publish AI Gateway plugin to the dev catalog

update-plugin-version.name: Pin the published version in dev

steps.name: Open the dev version pin pull request
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ "$PLUGIN_VERSION" != ?*"+$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
  echo "::error::published version '$PLUGIN_VERSION' does not end in +$GITHUB_SHA"
  exit 1
fi
head=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/main" --jq .object.sha)
if [[ ! "$head" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::could not read the head of main"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ "$head" != "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::skipping the dev pin: main moved from $GITHUB_SHA to $head, whose run pins its own version"
  exit 0
fi
config=$(jq -n \
  --arg version "$PLUGIN_VERSION" \
  --arg msg "Created by $GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID. This PR will auto-merge once CI has passed." \
  '{
    pull_request_branch_prefix: "auto-merge/updater/grafana-aigateway-app/dev",
    pull_request_enabled: true,
    pull_request_existing_strategy: "replace",
    pull_request_message: $msg,
    update_jsonnet_attribute_configs: [("dev0", "dev1") | {
      file_path: "ksonnet/environments/appplugins/grafana-aigateway-app/versions.libsonnet",
      jsonnet_key: .,
      jsonnet_value: $version
    }]
  }')
docker run --rm -e GITHUB_TOKEN -e CONFIG_JSON="$config" \
  us-docker.pkg.dev/grafanalabs-global/docker-deployment-tools-prod/updater
